review.rationale: Option A is the minimum justified next governance step. It strictly limits scope to a single SSH session and one readlink/lstat/shape-check sequence to classify the symlink target without any server writes, log reads, or redeployment authority. The classification contract is sound, privacy boundaries for noncanonical targets are correctly enforced (hash + length only), caps and stop conditions are tight, and all non-authorizations are explicitly declared. No repair, rollback, or redeployment is implied or permitted.
